panels.description: Explains the incident-triage question and the evidence scopes used on this read-only dashboard. CURRENT ranks suspects from current fleet telemetry in GLOBAL scope; Pipeline and Run ID do not filter suspects. No suspects means none were found in the current scope and does not prove the fleet is healthy Run coverage: IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE / UNKNOWN. Set range to run when OUT OF RANGE. Effective refresh: 60s · timezone: browser. Effective filters: provider=${provider}.

panels.title: Track Failed Workflow Steps
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Counts failed Workflow pipeline steps in the selected range for Workflow and Pipeline. The metric has no Stage label. Zero means no matching failures in the selected range, including when an empty selected-range result is rendered through noValue; it is neutral range evidence, not stage success or current Pipeline Health. Use runtime localization or Trust evidence when non-zero, and use Metrics Evidence to assess telemetry confidence. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

panels.title: Inspect Current Missing Stage Signals
panels.description: CURRENT · Expected stage coverage for Pipeline / Run Type. Missing lag/backlog signals are listed individually. Undefined expected stages are UNKNOWN. VALID EMPTY requires a recorded complete stage catalog and every expected signal. Query failures are QUERY ERROR.

CURRENT · Replay uses pipeline/run type counters over 15 minutes; Run ID does not filter this card. UNKNOWN means required telemetry or publication evidence is missing, not a confirmed processing failure. Inspect Telemetry Coverage below. Selected-run Trust is assessed separately from persisted evidence. Counts map to 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT; absent evidence remains UNKNOWN.
panels.title: Monitor Replay

panels.description: CURRENT · Last checkpoint age, informational only; age does not change readiness. Missing evidence remains UNKNOWN. Pipeline-scoped, independent of Run ID.
panels.title: Track Checkpoint

panels.description: TIME RANGE · CURRENT · Ledger uses pipeline/run type counters over 15 minutes; Run ID does not filter this card. UNKNOWN means required telemetry or publication evidence is missing, not a confirmed processing failure. Inspect Telemetry Coverage below. Selected-run Trust is assessed separately from persisted evidence. Counts map to 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT; absent evidence remains UNKNOWN.
panels.title: Monitor Ledger

panels.description: TIME RANGE · CURRENT · Required telemetry coverage over 5 minutes, independent of Run ID. CRIT means at least two required groups are missing; it does not count failed runs. Inspect Telemetry Coverage below for manifest, ledger, replay-risk, integrity and publication evidence. An empty Pushgateway after restart requires a genuine new publication or verified backup, never synthetic zero counters. Counts map to 0=OK, 1=WARN, >=2=CRIT; absent evidence remains UNKNOWN.
panels.title: Monitor Telemetry

options.content:
Coverage contract
  • Replay duplicate/overwrite risk is covered by bounded risk_type telemetry.
  • Manifest-to-ledger referential integrity is covered by complementary consistent / inconsistent ratio series.
  • A zero blocker verdict is trustworthy only while the telemetry-coverage card is complete.

panels.title: Review Coverage Limits
panels.description: Lists replay-safety conditions that this dashboard cannot fully prove. An empty blocker count is trustworthy only within the observed telemetry coverage.

TIME RANGE · Counts replay write risk, manifest/ledger integrity, checkpoint, manifest, ledger, drift, and lineage blockers during the selected time range. Zero means no blocker evidence was recorded; verify telemetry coverage before treating it as safe. Measured 0 requires present series; No data means metric/series absence and must not be treated as healthy zero.
panels.title: Track Replay Blockers

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Counts incompatible checkpoint decisions during the selected range. Any non-zero value blocks resume. Run Type does not affect this panel. No observations means this outcome has no samples in the selected window; it does not prove zero failures. A measured zero is displayed numerically. Missing counter evidence is UNKNOWN; measured zero means no observed events.
panels.title: Track Incompatibilities

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Counts replay attempts that could not be reconstructed during the selected range. Any non-zero value blocks replay. Run Type does not affect this panel. No observations means this outcome has no samples in the selected window; it does not prove zero failures. A measured zero is displayed numerically. Missing counter evidence is UNKNOWN; measured zero means no observed events.
panels.title: Track Unreconstructable

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Counts replay-drift events during the selected range. Any non-zero value requires stopping replay and inspecting the drift type. No observations means this outcome has no samples in the selected window; it does not prove zero failures. A measured zero is displayed numerically. Missing counter evidence is UNKNOWN; measured zero means no observed events.
panels.title: Track Replay Drift

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Counts failed checkpoint loads during the selected range. Run Type does not affect this panel. No observations means this outcome has no samples in the selected window; it does not prove zero failures. A measured zero is displayed numerically. Missing counter evidence is UNKNOWN; measured zero means no observed events.
panels.title: Track Load Failures

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Counts failed checkpoint saves during the selected range. Run Type does not affect this panel. No observations means this outcome has no samples in the selected window; it does not prove zero failures. A measured zero is displayed numerically. Missing counter evidence is UNKNOWN; measured zero means no observed events.
panels.title: Track Save Failures

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Counts failed checkpoint administration operations across all pipelines during the selected range. Pipeline and Run Type filters do not affect this panel. Zero means no failures were recorded in the selected range; it does not prove telemetry completeness. Measured 0 requires present series; No data means metric/series absence and must not be treated as healthy zero. No observations means this outcome has no samples in the selected window; it does not prove zero failures. A measured zero is displayed numerically. Missing counter evidence is UNKNOWN; measured zero means no observed events.
panels.title: Track Global Admin Failures

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Shows the highest replay lag during the selected range. Below 300s is normal, 300–899s is elevated, and >=900s is critical. No data means lag telemetry is unavailable.
panels.title: Track Peak Replay Lag

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Shows replay-drift events grouped by capability, drift type, and status. No data means either no events occurred or drift telemetry is unavailable. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.
panels.title: Track Replay Drift by Type

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Checkpoint compatibility decisions by outcome. An absent series is TELEMETRY MISSING and remains UNKNOWN. Run Type does not affect this panel.

defaults.noValue: TELEMETRY MISSING — series not emitted for this selector (not a zero)

panels.title: Compare Checkpoint Outcomes

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Shows replay lag over time by replay capability and status. No data means replay-lag telemetry is unavailable. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

defaults.noValue: TELEMETRY MISSING — series not emitted for this selector (not a zero)

panels.title: Track Replay Lag

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Shows p50, p95, and p99 checkpoint-save latency for the selected range. No data means no latency samples were recorded, not zero latency. Run Type does not affect this panel. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Histogram generation guard: windows with a changed producer creation timestamp are omitted for the whole aggregate. A repeated batch snapshot is not a continuous counter; narrow the window to one stable generation. Omitted values do not mean zero latency.

defaults.noValue: NO OBSERVATIONS — no usable histogram increments

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.50, (sum by (le, pipeline, operation) (increase(bioetl_checkpoint_save_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__range])) unless on (pipeline, operation) (sum by (pipeline, operation) (changes(bioetl_checkpoint_save_duration_seconds_created{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__range]) > 0))))) >= 0

(histogram_quantile(0.95, (sum by (le, pipeline, operation) (increase(bioetl_checkpoint_save_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__range])) unless on (pipeline, operation) (sum by (pipeline, operation) (changes(bioetl_checkpoint_save_duration_seconds_created{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__range]) > 0))))) >= 0

(histogram_quantile(0.99, (sum by (le, pipeline, operation) (increase(bioetl_checkpoint_save_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__range])) unless on (pipeline, operation) (sum by (pipeline, operation) (changes(bioetl_checkpoint_save_duration_seconds_created{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__range]) > 0))))) >= 0

panels.title: Track Checkpoint Save Latency

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Shows p50, p95, and p99 administration latency across all pipelines during the selected range. Filters do not affect this panel. No data is expected when no administration operations occurred in the selected range. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Histogram generation guard: windows with a changed producer creation timestamp are omitted for the whole aggregate. A repeated batch snapshot is not a continuous counter; narrow the window to one stable generation. Omitted values do not mean zero latency.

defaults.noValue: No GLOBAL checkpoint operator latency samples in range. This is optional admin/operator telemetry, not pipeline success evidence.

panels.title: Track Global Checkpoint Admin Latency

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Selected range: last observed terminal counter by status, summed across matching series. Pipeline applies; Run ID and Run Type do not. This is a counter snapshot, not an exact-run verdict or a count of events within the range. A first sample of 1 followed by 1 has observed value 1 but measured increase 0. No matching series is a valid empty state (UNKNOWN), not a zero. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero.

defaults.noValue: TELEMETRY MISSING — series not emitted for this selector (not a zero)

panels.title: Review Observed Terminal Counters

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Counts failed ledger appends during the selected range. Any non-zero value requires checking the run ledger. Run Type does not affect this panel. Role: selected-range failure count ($__range); the 30m fail-rate gate on this row is Monitor Ledger Failures (133).
panels.title: Track Ledger Failures

panels.description: TIME RANGE · SELECTED RUN · Counts failed manifest writes during the selected range. Any non-zero value requires checking manifest persistence before replay or resume. Role: selected-range failure count ($__range); the 30m fail-rate gate on this row is Monitor Manifest Failures (132).
panels.title: Track Manifest Failures

panels.description: TIME RANGE · SELECTED RUN · Shows manifest-write failure severity over the last 30 minutes. Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, 2=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN. Confirm telemetry coverage before trusting OK. Role: 30m fail-rate gate (ratio), not the selected-range count in Track Manifest Write Failures (1).
panels.title: Monitor Manifest (30m)

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Shows ledger-append failure severity over the last 30 minutes. Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=WARN, 2=CRIT, null=UNKNOWN. Run Type does not affect this panel. Role: 30m fail-rate gate (ratio), not the selected-range count in Track Ledger Append Failures (2).
panels.title: Monitor Ledger (30m)

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Sampled counter increase per interval, by run type and status. Pipeline and Run Type apply; Run ID does not. Zero means no increase between available samples, not no manifest writes. An event already included in the first sample cannot be counted by increase(). Inspect persisted run evidence for exact-run outcomes. Empty chart is UNKNOWN telemetry, not a healthy zero. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero.

defaults.noValue: TELEMETRY MISSING — series not emitted for this selector (not a zero)

panels.title: Track Observed Manifest Write Increments

panels.description: CURRENT · TIME RANGE · Shows ledger appends over time by event type and status. This is historical evidence. Run Type does not affect this panel. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

defaults.noValue: TELEMETRY MISSING — series not emitted for this selector (not a zero)

panels.title: Compare Ledger Appends by Type & Status

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Counts failed reads across all control-plane stores during the selected range. Pipeline and Run Type filters do not apply. Role: selected-range failure count ($__range); the 30m fail-rate gate on this row is Monitor Global Read Failures (136). No observations means this outcome has no samples in the selected window; it does not prove zero failures. A measured zero is displayed numerically. Missing counter evidence is UNKNOWN; measured zero means no observed events.
panels.title: Track Global Read Failures

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Shows global read failure severity over the last 30 minutes. Status mapping: 0=OK at <=5%, 1=WARN at >5%, 2=CRIT at >10%, null=UNKNOWN. Role: 30m fail-rate gate (ratio), not the selected-range count in Track Global Read Failures (4). No observations means this outcome has no samples in the selected window; it does not prove zero failures. A measured zero is displayed numerically.
panels.title: Monitor Global Read Failures (30m)

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Shows read operations by store, operation, and status across all pipelines. Dashboard filters do not apply. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Axis: reads per Grafana interval ($__interval); K is thousands of reads.

defaults.noValue: TELEMETRY MISSING — series not emitted for this selector (not a zero)

panels.title: Compare Global Reads by Store

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Default p95 read latency by store and operation; change Read latency to p50 or p99. Excludes failed reads (status!="failed"). Filters do not apply. Values are seconds; the axis auto-scales (milliseconds display as ms). No data means no latency samples were recorded in the selected range. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Histogram generation guard: windows with a changed producer creation timestamp are omitted for the whole aggregate. A repeated batch snapshot is not a continuous counter; narrow the window to one stable generation. Omitted values do not mean zero latency.

defaults.noValue: NO OBSERVATIONS — no usable histogram increments

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile($read_latency_quantile, (sum by (le, store, operation) (increase(bioetl_control_plane_read_duration_seconds_bucket{status!="failed"}[$__range])) unless on (store, operation) (sum by (store, operation) (changes(bioetl_control_plane_read_duration_seconds_created{status!="failed"}[$__range]) > 0))))) >= 0

panels.title: Compare Lineage Persistence Outcomes

panels.description: CURRENT · Worst coverage in selected pipeline/run type scope. PRESENT means series observed, not successful processing. Publication requires an original positive timestamp no later than now; age alone is informational. Run ID and dashboard time range do not change these fixed-window checks.
panels.title: Inspect Telemetry Coverage
Inspect Selected Run Domains
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved evidence for the exact Run ID. Completion age and chart range do not change this verdict. CURRENT uses fresh telemetry and retains its 15-minute freshness rule. Historical Trust never authorizes replay now. Missing checks are INCOMPLETE; missing selection is SELECT RUN; request failure is QUERY ERROR. N/A means explicitly inapplicable. VALID EMPTY is an empty successful query; backend down is QUERY ERROR. Chart coverage is separate: use Set range to run in Run Explorer to inspect a partial or outside range. Inspect the report for rules, revision, completion and the saved source evidence.

selection_required.text: Choose a run to inspect saved evidence

panels.title: Inspect Selected Run Identity
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved evidence for the exact Run ID. Completion age and chart range do not change this verdict. CURRENT uses fresh telemetry and retains its 15-minute freshness rule. Historical Trust never authorizes replay now. Missing checks are INCOMPLETE; missing selection is SELECT RUN; request failure is QUERY ERROR. N/A means explicitly inapplicable. VALID EMPTY is an empty successful query; backend down is QUERY ERROR. Chart coverage is separate: use Set range to run in Run Explorer to inspect a partial or outside range. Inspect the report for rules, revision, completion and the saved source evidence.

panels.title: Inspect Selected Run Stages
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Saved stage rows for the exact Run ID. SUCCESS with missing stage evidence stays INCOMPLETE. A recorded zero stays 0. An unknown count is empty, not 0. UNFINISHED means no terminal event. Prometheus does not change this table.

panels.title: Review Current Workflow Evidence
panels.description: CURRENT · Workflow/pipeline/run-type scope, independent of Selected Run. Published at is the gateway publication clock, not the Prometheus evaluation clock. Retained publications do not expire after 15 minutes. Reason unavailable means no diagnostic cause is exposed by this metric.
